title: Not A Very Good Juicer
text:
Not A Very Good Juicer. This juicer leaves much to be desired. Yes, it is on the cheap end. But you are going to waste so much produce with this thing. The pulp is super wet when you're done, telling you there was a lot more juice you could have gotten out of your produce. It also skips big hunks at time. I found entire apple slices in the pulp bin. It doesn't do a great job at straining. About half the time I have to restrain my juice because there is too much pulp in it. (And big pieces of pulp.)
It does come apart completely for washing. Though I wouldn't recommend putting the pieces in the dishwasher.
I wouldn't really recommend this juicer to anyone. It is cheap, but you'll end up wasting all you saved in produce.
